what: Pin the section to the screen (+=12000, scrub 1) pinned, a white circle in the center grows 0→1 (2) and the side images switch on 1.5 later. Each speech bubble turns on in .8 (power2.out), and each time the conversation line lifts that bubble to the circle center in 1 (power2.inOut) and rests .4. When all are on, the conversation vanishes and a photo pile appears at .8x at 2 and spins, each at its own tilt angle (1.5, .1 stagger). While the circle grows 6x to cover the screen (3, expo.inOut), photos scatter to their places from .5 later (4, .08 stagger, expo.out) and the final panel (Contact) turns on at 2

options.show · move · pause: Speech bubble on .8 · conversation raise 1 · pause .4 (timeline’s share)
options.cover: Scale at which the circle covers the screen, default 6
options.narrow: Narrow-screen condition, default (max-width: 1023px) — in that case photos check data-sp-x, data-sp-y, data-sp-r first
options.[data-fx-part=orb]·[data-fx-part=feed]·[: Circle · conversation lines inside the circle · speech bubble (data-side="me" Surface right green)
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo — data-x·data-y (scatter position, vw·vh etc.) · data-r (tilt in degrees)
options.[data-fx-part=side]·[data-fx-part=end]: Side images · panel that lights up at the end (optional)
options.--fx-orb · --fx-photo · --fx-frame · --f: Circle diameter · photo width · photo white border · circle fill
